purpose: Cross-type carrier-admissibility discriminator over finite probe tables.
claim_ceiling: For these finite fixtures only: multiplicity across non-isomorphic carrier categories means the carrier type is installed, while UNSAT rows give fixture-local exclusions. The quotient carrier is a near-trivial null baseline with one bounded free variable per measured probe. The load-bearing carrier-type negative is the order_gap_clean classical_noncontextual exclusion: ZX=1/4 versus XZ=3/8 violates the non-disturbing classical joint. The y_phase real_rebit exclusion is by_construction because a real-symmetric rebit has Y=1/2 identically; it is a boundary/control, not load-bearing. The Luders readout maps encode one chosen measurement geometry, so the clean order-gap exclusion is fixture-local contextuality-flavored evidence under that geometry, not a general contextuality theorem. This does not exclude rho, does not promote beyond scratch_diagnostic, and leaves the Rung-0.5 Boolean/counting fork held.
decision_rule: For each carrier type T and fixture F, run an SMT existence search with free type-T variables and readout_T(C, probe) == measured_probe. SAT means T is admitted/allowed. UNSAT means T is excluded/negative. UNKNOWN on a headline verdict fails the build.

carrier_type_non_isomorphism.basis: structural category difference, not a hardcoded witness carrier
carrier_type_non_isomorphism.quotient: finite probe-outcome fingerprint row with one free bounded readout variable per measured probe
carrier_type_non_isomorphism.classical_noncontextual: simplex over deterministic Z/X/Y value assignments with non-disturbing sequential readout
carrier_type_non_isomorphism.real_rebit: real-symmetric 2x2 PSD trace-1 density matrix rho_R=[[a,b],[b,1-a]]
carrier_type_non_isomorphism.complex_rho: complex Hermitian 2x2 PSD trace-1 density matrix rho=[[a,b-i*c],[b+i*c,1-a]]

probe_readouts.ZX: joint probability of Z=+ then X=+ under projective/Luders sequential readout, or non-disturbing classical joint
probe_readouts.XZ: joint probability of X=+ then Z=+ under projective/Luders sequential readout, or non-disturbing classical joint

classical_noncontextual.validity: weights w_zxy >= 0 over deterministic z,x,y in {+,-}; sum weights = 1
classical_noncontextual.XZ: sum_{x=+,z=+} w_zxy, equal to ZX because the model is non-disturbing

order_gap_exclusion.narration: Over-determined classical exclusion: Z=1 already pins the noncontextual joint through the marginal, so this is marginal plus order-gap pressure rather than the isolated contextuality negative.

order_gap_clean.narration: Clean isolated order-gap fixture under the chosen Luders maps: Z=1/2 and X=3/4 give measured ZX=1/4 and XZ=3/8. Classical_noncontextual is excluded only by non-disturbance because each single-joint branch is SAT, while the joint constraint forces one classical J to equal both 1/4 and 3/8.

y_phase_exclusion.boundary_control_for: real_rebit has no Y degree of freedom: real_rebit.Y is fixed at 1/2, so measured Y=3/4 is outside the class by design.

invalid_probability.reason: With reproduce ON, bounded-probability carriers are UNSAT. With reproduce OFF, each carrier type has a valid free witness.

surviving_alternatives: rho/complex carrier is admitted on some fixtures but not forced by finite probe data.
Classical noncontextual carriers remain admitted on marginal-only and Y-phase fixtures but are excluded by the clean order-gap fixture under the chosen measurement geometry.
